datasets.name: 9c066e52
queryLines:
SELECT
  sku_id,
  location_id,
  SUM(closing_stock) as closing_stock
FROM
  supply_chain.gold.inventory_snapshot
GROUP BY
  sku_id,
  location_id
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: e9a28ecd
queryLines:
SELECT
  sku_id,
  total_demand,
  total_supply,
  gap,
  CASE
    WHEN gap > 0 THEN 'SHORTAGE'
    WHEN gap < 0 THEN 'EXCESS'
    ELSE 'BALANCED'
  END AS status
FROM
  supply_chain.gold.demand_supply_gap
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: 4ca61970
datasets.displayName: Top Four Supply Demand Gap Status Summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  g.sku_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_name, g.sku_id) AS product_label,
  g.total_demand,
  g.total_supply,
  g.gap,
  CASE
    WHEN g.gap > 0 THEN 'SHORTAGE'
    WHEN g.gap < 0 THEN 'EXCESS'
    ELSE 'BALANCED'
  END AS status
FROM
  supply_chain.gold.demand_supply_gap g
    LEFT JOIN supply_chain.silver.products_catalog p
      ON g.sku_id = p.sku_id
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: 3ddf3990
datasets.displayName: Supplier Performance Metrics and Status Overview
queryLines:
SELECT
  s.supplier_id,
  s.supplier_name,
  CONCAT(s.supplier_name, ' (', s.supplier_id, ')') AS supplier_label,
  p.avg_open_qty,
  p.avg_received_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN p.avg_open_qty = 0 THEN 'EXCELLENT'
    WHEN p.avg_open_qty < 5 THEN 'GOOD'
    ELSE 'POOR'
  END AS performance_status
FROM
  supply_chain.gold.supplier_performance p
    LEFT JOIN supply_chain.silver.suppliers s
      ON p.sup_id = s.supplier_id

datasets.name: 5caa8ff2
queryLines:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_open_qty = 0 THEN 'EXCELLENT'
        WHEN avg_open_qty < 5 THEN 'GOOD'
        ELSE 'POOR'
    END AS performance_status,
    COUNT(*) AS supplier_count
FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_performance
GROUP BY performance_status;

datasets.name: 3659d188
queryLines:
SELECT 
    booking_type,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM supply_chain.silver.silver_loads
GROUP BY booking_type;

datasets.name: edabb80d
datasets.displayName: Fuel Cost and Extra Charges Summary
queryLines:
SELECT 
    'Fuel Cost' AS cost_type,
    SUM(fuel_surcharge) AS amount
FROM supply_chain.silver.silver_loads

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Accessorial Charges' AS cost_type,
    SUM(accessorial_charges) AS amount
FROM supply_chain.silver.silver_loads;

datasets.name: 76564f48
datasets.displayName: Booking Type Revenue Cost and Profit Summary
queryLines:
SELECT 
    booking_type,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(fuel_surcharge + accessorial_charges) AS total_cost,
    SUM(revenue - (fuel_surcharge + accessorial_charges)) AS profit,
    ROUND(
        SUM(revenue - (fuel_surcharge + accessorial_charges)) * 100.0 / SUM(revenue),
        2
    ) AS profit_margin
FROM supply_chain.silver.silver_loads
GROUP BY booking_type;

datasets.name: 20e1afff
datasets.displayName: Shipment Detention Analysis by Warehouse and Time Intervals
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_id AS shipment_id,
  facility_id AS warehouse_id,
  scheduled_datetime AS arrival_time,
  actual_datetime AS loading_start_time,
  detention_minutes,
  CASE
    WHEN detention_minutes > 60 THEN 'HIGH'
    WHEN detention_minutes > 30 THEN 'MEDIUM'
    ELSE 'LOW'
  END AS detention_level
FROM
  supply_chain.silver.silver_delivery_events
LIMIT 20;

datasets.name: delivery_status
queryLines:
WITH order_events AS (
  SELECT
    load_id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN event_type = 'DELIVERY' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_delivery,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN event_type = 'PICKUP' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_pickup
  FROM
    supply_chain.silver.silver_delivery_events
  GROUP BY
    load_id
),
all_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    load_id
  FROM
    supply_chain.silver.silver_loads
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN oe.has_delivery = 1 THEN 'Delivered'
    WHEN
      oe.has_pickup = 1
      AND oe.has_delivery = 0
    THEN
      'In Transit'
    ELSE 'Not Delivered'
  END AS delivery_status,
  COUNT(ao.load_id) AS order_count
FROM
  all_orders ao
    LEFT JOIN order_events oe
      ON ao.load_id = oe.load_id
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN oe.has_delivery = 1 THEN 'Delivered'
    WHEN
      oe.has_pickup = 1
      AND oe.has_delivery = 0
    THEN
      'In Transit'
    ELSE 'Not Delivered'
  END

datasets.name: in_transit_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN delivery_status = 'In Transit' THEN order_count
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS in_transit_count
FROM
  (
    WITH order_events AS (
      SELECT
        load_id,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN event_type = 'DELIVERY' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) AS has_delivery,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN event_type = 'PICKUP' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) AS has_pickup
      FROM
        supply_chain.silver.silver_delivery_events
      GROUP BY
        load_id
    )
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN
          oe.has_pickup = 1
          AND oe.has_delivery = 0
        THEN
          'In Transit'
        ELSE 'Other'
      END AS delivery_status,
      COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM
      supply_chain.silver.silver_loads ao
        LEFT JOIN order_events oe
          ON ao.load_id = oe.load_id
    GROUP BY
      CASE
        WHEN
          oe.has_pickup = 1
          AND oe.has_delivery = 0
        THEN
          'In Transit'
        ELSE 'Other'
      END
